requirement.evidence: In Berkeley, tenants in units that are fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance cannot be evicted unless there is "just cause” (previously called “good cause”).
requirement.note: Contact-the-Rent-Board advice is supported by the notice requirement that notices state advice is available from the Rent Board.

key_value.evidence: For a landlord to evict a tenant for nonpayment of rent, the tenant must owe an amount of rental debt equal to or greater than one month of the Fair Market Rent (FMR) value for a unit of equivalent size in the metro area Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR as determined by the US Department of Housing and Urban Development for the fiscal year in which the rent is demanded.

status.evidence: In Berkeley, tenants in units that are fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance cannot be evicted unless there is "just cause” (previously called “good cause”).
status.note: Document presents the rule as current law.

citation.evidence: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election, makes several changes to Berkeley’s Rent Ordinance that affect tenant and landlord rights and responsibilities.
citation.note: Document supports the Rent Ordinance as amended by Measure BB, Nov. 2024, but gives no section number.

requirement.evidence: The maximum AGA is 5%. This means that, if the formula in the Rent Ordinance results in an AGA that is greater than 5%, the AGA approved by the Board for that year can be no more than 5%. This cap does not prevent a landlord who has “banked” (unused) AGAs from previous years from implementing a rent increase that is greater than 5% in order to raise the rent to the rent ceiling.
requirement.note: Fully covered units having a rent ceiling limited by the AGA is also stated.

key_value.evidence: The elected Rent Board sets the AGA by following a formula in the Rent Ordinance that ties the AGA to the Consumer Price Index.

coverage.evidence: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980
coverage.note: Document says built before 1980 for fully covered; the card's built_on_or_before 1980-12-31 and certificate-of-occupancy basis is not stated for fully covered units.
